subject: English
passage: A collection of medieval manuscripts contains illuminated texts to attract scholarly attention. However, in some cases, the decorations the library uses to enhance interest in the collection actually ______ its appeal to researchers. The British Museum, for example, not only welcomes elaborate illustrations but actually prioritizes them for digitization in the same way the original scribes intended.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation: Choice B is the best answer. The convention being tested is subject-verb agreement. The plural verb "increase" agrees in number with the plural subject "decorations."
